source_text.body:
Call a dentist's office to book an appointment
The poster used Muse to phone their dentist about an appointment; the office seemed to notice it was an AI and booking failed over missing insurance information.
·
Oct 17, 2026
Done with
MM
Meta Muse
What they did
The poster used Muse’s phone-calling feature to contact their dentist and ask for a routine checkup during the week of November 2. In the shared transcript, the AI introduced itself, requested the appointment, answered spelling and hold questions, then stopped when the office asked for insurance details it did not have; the person later said they had assumed the office already kept that on file.
How it went
The call did not book an appointment. The office appeared to notice it was an AI, and the poster said they would likely try again after giving Muse the needed information.
Worth knowing
A useful catch from the comments: the calling agent may only get a short prep note, so missing details like insurance can cause the call to fail.
Try it yourself
with
Meta Muse
Copy prompt
Call [dentist's name] at [phone number] and ask to book a [type of appointment] for me in [preferred dates and times]. Have my insurance details ready: [insurer, member ID], and tell them you are an AI assistant calling for [my name]. If they need information you don't have, stop and tell me what's missing. Before confirming any booking, check the date and time with me.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/MuseAgent/comments/1xb3tx5/funny_muse_call_with_my_dentists_office
